title: Fresh arXiv candidates for embodied pretraining data sources and capture parameters
page_text: Fresh primary-source candidates discovered through targeted web search after the official arXiv API returned no records for the future-dated local review window. Candidates cover heterogeneous human/robot/simulation VLA pretraining, viewpoint action, hardware-agnostic transfer, multi-embodiment motion transfer, and task-aware visual compression.
